create_BaseLogger: create a BaseLogger instance with agent_id, output_directory, and required_topics to log robot data to MCAP files
start_session: start a logging session with start_session providing start_nsec, task_id, and optional output_file_prefix
write_proto_message: write a protobuf message to the log file using write_proto_message with topic, message, and publish_time_nsec
stop_session: stop the current logging session and finalize the MCAP file by calling stop_session with stop_nsec
start_outside_session_logging: start logging outside a session using start_outside_session_logging with start_nsec and output_file_prefix
